title: The Hidden Giant
narration: Every sunrise hides a mystery. One star holds 99.86% of our solar system's mass. Meet the Sun.
visual_goal: Sunrise over Earth, then zoom to Sun's blazing surface.

title: Journey to the Core
narration: At its heart, 15 million degrees Celsius. The surface? Just 5,500. A 1.39-million-kilometer inferno.
visual_goal: Cutaway animation from surface to core, showing temperature contrast.

title: The Ancient Engine
narration: It burns hydrogen—73%—for 4.6 billion years. Each second, it outputs 3.8 × 10^26 watts. Our light.
visual_goal: Sun's composition diagram, then solar flares and energy waves.

title: Touch the Corona
narration: A spacecraft 'touched' the corona—a million degrees—and survived. It rotates every 27 days, yet we walk beneath it daily.
visual_goal: Parker Solar Probe spiraling near Sun, corona glow.

title: Your Star
narration: In 5 billion years, it will swell into a red giant. But today, 149.6 million kilometers away—it's simply yours. Cherish it.
visual_goal: Time-lapse star to red giant, then back to quiet Sun over Earth.
